findings.title: Ubiquiti UniFi Multi-Product Batch — CVE-2026-50746 (Max Severity) Command Injection in UniFi Connect + 6 Critical CVEs Across UniFi Talk / Access / Protect / OS Server / Routers; ~100k Instances Exposed
findings.affected_technology: Ubiquiti UniFi Connect Application (≤ 3.4.16), UniFi Talk, UniFi Access, UniFi Protect, UniFi OS Server, UniFi routers/gateways/NAS/surveillance
findings.summary: Ubiquiti disclosed 7 critical/max-severity vulns on 2026-07-09 topped by CVE-2026-50746 (network-adjacent unauth Command Injection via Improper Access Control in UniFi Connect); Censys tracks ~100k exposed UniFi OS instances with ~50k in the US and prior state-sponsored targeting history.

findings.title: GhostApproval (Wiz) — Symlink Sandbox-Escape in Six AI Coding Agents (Amazon Q, Claude Code, Cursor, Google Antigravity, Windsurf, Augment); AWS CVE-2026-12958 + Cursor CVE-2026-50549; Anthropic Initially Disputed, Now Fixed in Claude Code 2.1.173+
findings.affected_technology: Amazon Q Developer (language server < 1.69.0), Anthropic Claude Code (< 2.1.173), Cursor, Google Antigravity, Windsurf, Augment
findings.summary: Wiz disclosed 2026-07-08 that six AI coding agents fail to resolve symlinks before write-approval; a malicious repo project_settings.json→~/.zshrc lands RCE on the developer host — an 'informed-consent bypass' since the approval dialog shows the safe filename while the agent writes to the symlink target.

findings.title: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS 2026-07-09 Batch — 13 Vulns Including CVE-2026-0288 (CVSS 9.2) User-ID TSA Unauth Buffer Overflow RCE, CVE-2026-0265 CAS Auth Bypass, and CVE-2026-0300 (CVSS 9.3) Captive Portal Buffer Overflow
findings.affected_technology: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS 11.1, 11.2, 12.1 on PA-Series firewalls, VM-Series, Panorama
findings.summary: Palo Alto disclosed 13 PAN-OS vulns on 2026-07-09 topped by unauth memory-corruption RCE in User-ID Terminal Server Agent (CVE-2026-0288, CVSS 9.2), Cloud Authentication Service auth bypass (CVE-2026-0265), and User-ID Captive Portal buffer overflow (CVE-2026-0300, CVSS 9.3) — vendor-highest urgency rating, no in-the-wild yet reported.

findings.title: Roundcube In-the-Wild Exploitation Campaign — UNK_MassTraction (China-Aligned) Weaponises CVE-2024-42009 XSS + CVE-2025-49113 Deserialization Against US/Canada Academic Targets; Proofpoint Discloses May-Onwards Activity
findings.affected_technology: Roundcube Webmail (unpatched instances vulnerable to either CVE)
findings.summary: Proofpoint on 2026-07-08 detailed the China-aligned UNK_MassTraction cluster exploiting long-patched Roundcube XSS + deserialization since May 2026 against US and Canadian physics/engineering/national-security researchers via malicious emails deploying IceCube stealer + SquareShell/VShell webshells.
